title: insight emergent properties
summary: The thread discusses six properties related to emergent behaviors in codebases, focusing on structural and functional asymmetries, registration patterns, and the evolution of code through additive-substrate growth. The properties highlight how the codebase's structure and history reflect both intentional and unintentional design choices, with some aspects being more prominent than others. The thread concludes with a catalog of six properties, two of which were declined, emphasizing the cumulative nature of insight threads.
